sequenceDiagram(name = "API_Gateway_Rate_Limiting") {
    val client = lifeline(name = "Client") { isActor = true }
    val apiGateway = lifeline(name = "API Gateway")
    val rateLimiter = lifeline(name = "Rate Limiter")
    val backendService = lifeline(name = "Backend Service")

    message(from = client, to = apiGateway, label = "Request Data")
    message(from = apiGateway, to = rateLimiter, label = "Check Quota")
    reply(from = rateLimiter, to = apiGateway, label = "Quota Available?")
    
    // If quota is available
    message(from = apiGateway, to = backendService, label = "Forward Request")
    reply(from = backendService, to = apiGateway, label = "Data")
    reply(from = apiGateway, to = client, label = "Return Data")

    // If quota is not available
    reply(from = rateLimiter, to = apiGateway, label = "No Quota")
    reply(from = apiGateway, to = client, label = "Reject - Too Many Requests")
    
    // Retry logic
    message(from = client, to = apiGateway, label = "Retry Request")
    message(from = apiGateway, to = rateLimiter, label = "Check Quota")
    reply(from = rateLimiter, to = apiGateway, label = "Quota Available?")
    
    // If quota is available after retry
    message(from = apiGateway, to = backendService, label = "Forward Request")
    reply(from = backendService, to = apiGateway, label = "Data")
    reply(from = apiGateway, to = client, label = "Return Data")

    // If quota is still not available after retry
    reply(from = rateLimiter, to = apiGateway, label = "No Quota")
    reply(from = apiGateway, to = client, label = "Reject - Too Many Requests")
}

sequenceDiagram(name = "APIGatewayOrderFlow") {
    val client = lifeline(name = "Client") { isActor = true }
    val apiGateway = lifeline(name = "API Gateway")
    val tokenCache = lifeline(name = "Token Cache")
    val authSvc = lifeline(name = "Authentication Service")
    val orderSvc = lifeline(name = "Order Service")

    message(from = client, to = apiGateway, label = "Call /order endpoint with JWT")
    message(from = apiGateway, to = tokenCache, label = "Check cache for token")

    alt Token not in cache
        message(from = apiGateway, to = authSvc, label = "Verify token")
        reply(from = authSvc, to = apiGateway, label = "Validation result")
        message(from = apiGateway, to = tokenCache, label = "Store validation result")
    end

    alt Token is valid
        message(from = apiGateway, to = orderSvc, label = "Forward request")
        reply(from = orderSvc, to = apiGateway, label = "Order list")
        message(from = apiGateway, to = client, label = "Return order list")
    else Token is invalid
        message(from = apiGateway, to = client, label = "Access denied")
    end
}

    val customer = lifeline(name = "Customer") { isActor = true }
    val orderService = lifeline(name = "Order Service")

    val warehouseService = lifeline(name = "Warehouse Service")
    val paymentService = lifeline(name = "Payment Service")
    val shipmentService = lifeline(name = "Shipment Service")
    val eventLog = lifeline(name = "Event Log")

    message(from = sagaOrchestrator, to = warehouseService, label = "reserveItems()")
    reply(from = warehouseService, to = sagaOrchestrator, label = "reservationResult")
    
    // If reservation successful
    message(from = sagaOrchestrator, to = paymentService, label = "processPayment()")
    reply(from = paymentService, to = sagaOrchestrator, label = "paymentResult")
    
    // If payment successful
    message(from = sagaOrchestrator, to = shipmentService, label = "createShipment()")

    val authServer = lifeline(name = "Auth Server")

    val auditLog = lifeline(name = "Audit Log")
    val resourceServer = lifeline(name = "Resource Server")

    message(from = user, to = clientApp, label = "Initiate Login")
    message(from = clientApp, to = browser, label = "Redirect to Auth Server")
    message(from = browser, to = authServer, label = "Request Login Form")
    message(from = authServer, to = sessionStore, label = "Create Session")
    reply(from = sessionStore, to = authServer, label = "Session Created")
    reply(from = authServer, to = browser, label = "Login Form")
    reply(from = browser, to = clientApp, label = "Login Form Rendered")

    message(from = authServer, to = sessionStore, label = "Verify Session")

    message(from = authServer, to = auditLog, label = "Log Token Issuance")

    reply(from = authServer, to = clientApp, label = "Access Token")
